basic_details.job_title: RITES Senior Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: RITES Limited (a Government of India Enterprise, a Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Railways) is hiring 6 Senior Technical Assistant (Draftsman/Buildings) on a regular basis for Civil/Architecture (RG/48/26, 4 posts) and Electrical (RG/49/26, 2 posts), at pay Rs. 26,000-96,000. Diploma holders aged up to 32 years with 2 years' experience can apply online at www.rites.com from 16 November 2026 to 15 December 2026.

application_fee.details: SC/ST/PwBD candidates applying against unreserved posts of their category also pay the full fee at the application stage. Fee paid by SC/ST/PwBD candidates is refunded when they take part in the further selection process, after their category certificate is submitted and checked, less GST/bank charges, to the original account/card used. They must submit the certificate on the portal while paying. Fee paid by any method other than the prescribed one is not accepted and the application is rejected. For fee problems the helpdesk number is 011-33557000, extension code 13221, and the helpdesk email is [email protected].

age_limit.details: The age limit is 32 years for both posts, counted as on 15 December 2026. Relaxation is given on production of the required certificate. | Category Relaxation SC/ST 5 years OBC (NCL) 3 years Jammu and Kashmir domicile 5 years PwBD (benchmark disability) 10 years; additional relaxation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL) PwBD, subject to the post being identified as suitable RITES regular/contract employees who meet the qualification and experience criteria 5 years | Ex-servicemen are also mentioned among the categories for reservation, relaxation and concession as per Government orders, where applicable. Persons with disabilities from the identified categories (locomotor disability and hearing impairment for both posts) may apply even if no vacancy is specially reserved for them, and are considered on the general eligibility standard.

syllabus.details: RG/48/26 (Civil or Architecture): drawing practice and CAD, architectural design, building types and site planning, building materials, building construction, building planning and services, RCC and steel structures, estimation and quantity surveying, surveying, fire safety, green buildings and energy codes, and contemporary construction technology. RG/49/26 (Electrical): drawing practice and CAD, basic electrical engineering, AC fundamentals, electrical materials and basic electronics, electrical machines, measurement and instruments, electrical power systems, switchgear, protection and earthing, and wiring, estimation and utilisation.

how_to_apply: Make sure you meet the conditions for the post, as the notice says RITES does not examine eligibility in detail while receiving online applications.
Apply online through the registration programme in the Career section of www.rites.com.
Note the Registration Number the system generates at the top of the online form; it is needed for later contact with RITES.
Fill in the identity proof details carefully, as the original is needed in later stages of selection.
After filling in the details under the application form option, submit the application.
Upload all documents that support your claims, with clear and legible scanned copies, before submitting.
Pay the fee in the Payment section and, after successful payment, download the final application form.
Keep a signed print of the application with the Registration Number. Do not send hard copies of documents by post or courier.

The notice states that the application is considered incomplete and rejected if fee payment is not successful. Candidates should make sure an invoice is generated on payment; if it cannot be downloaded, they should immediately email [email protected] with registration details. One application per vacancy code is to be submitted, and a submitted application cannot be changed. A valid email ID is needed. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application with the prescribed fee for each, at their own risk, since the selection schedule for two posts may fall at the same time.
Documents to upload with the online form:
High school certificate as proof of date of birth
Academic and professional qualification certificates with marksheets of all semesters/years
Percentage conversion document issued by the university/institute, where applicable
EWS/SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD certificate in the Government of India format, where applicable
Proof of identity and address (passport, voter ID, driving licence, Aadhaar etc.) and PAN card
Experience proof in a single PDF in chronological order (offer letter, appointment order, relieving order, service certificate, pay slips)
Any other certificate supporting the candidature

At document verification, candidates bring one recent passport-size colour photo, the signed print of the online application, the duly filled Annexure-A checklist with self-attested copies in order, and originals. The Annexure-A checklist also lists 2 recent passport-size colour photos. For current employment, proof such as a joining letter with last month's pay slip or Form-16 is needed. For CTC/salary proof, the last Form-16, appraisal letter or pay slip is shown again on the day of the interview.
important_instructions: Employees of RITES need to apply online and submit their hard copy through the proper channel. Government department/PSU employees working on a regular basis must apply through proper channel. Those applying directly must bring a No Objection Certificate at the interview (if called). An NOC submitted after the fixed date is not accepted. Selected serving government/PSU employees are allowed to join only after being duly relieved by their parent organisation. OBC (NCL) and SC/ST candidates need a caste certificate in the prescribed annexure format valid up to the closing date. An OBC (NCL) certificate should be not more than one year old from the last date, and OBC (NCL) candidates give a declaration in Annexure-III format at verification. EWS candidates need an income and asset certificate in Government of India format valid for FY 2026-27, as on the last date. Those who cannot produce a valid certificate are treated as unreserved. An offer letter is not accepted as experience proof; a joining and relieving order or experience certificate is needed. Where the qualification requires a specialisation, a certificate from the university/institute clearly naming it is needed. No train/bus fare, TA or DA is payable, and legal jurisdiction in any dispute is Delhi. Applying, qualifying or taking part in selection gives no right to be selected; false information or concealment can lead to cancellation, and service termination even after appointment. The management may cancel, restrict, extend, modify or change the recruitment at any stage, without notice or reasons. Corrigenda and addenda are shown only on www.rites.com. Queries go only to [email protected] with the vacancy code, registration number/roll number, full name in capitals and valid email ID. RITES is not responsible for failure to submit an application caused by problems reported at the last minute.

content_sections.heading: About RITES
content_sections.text: RITES Limited is a Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Railways, Government of India. The notice describes it as a leading multidisciplinary consultancy organisation in transport, infrastructure and related technologies. Its office is at Shikhar, Plot No.-1, Sector-29, Gurugram, 122001. The notice says that in any dispute the English original text will be valid.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 6 vacancies in total across two vacancy codes. The break-up below is copied from the notice; dashes mean no post. One post under RG/48/26 is horizontally reserved for persons with benchmark disabilities; the notice's category-wise break-up shows 1 post in the third identified category column. The notice says the number of vacancies may change.

rows.post: Senior Technical Assistant (Draftsman/Buildings) - Civil or Architecture

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens aged 18 years or above can apply. Age, experience and all other eligibility are counted as on the cut-off date, 15 December 2026. Candidates with a higher qualification but without the stated essential qualification are not eligible. Minimum 50% marks in the essential qualification are needed by UR/EWS candidates, and by SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD candidates applying against unreserved posts. Reserved-category candidates (SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD, as applicable) need at least 45% against reserved posts. Where the certificate or marksheet shows no percentage, a conversion formula from the university/institute is needed; if none exists, an undertaking signed by an authorised representative is required, and 5 on a 10-point scale is treated as 50%. Training (other than on-the-job), internship, teaching, fellowship and PhD research are not counted as experience. Apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961 in the relevant field counts as post-qualification experience, if all other criteria are met. The qualification must be from a university or institution recognised as set out in the notice (BTE/AICTE recognised, as applicable); equivalent qualifications need an equivalence certificate. The age limit is 32 years for both posts, counted as on 15 December 2026. Relaxation is given on production of the required certificate. Ex-servicemen are also mentioned among the categories for reservation, relaxation and concession as per Government orders, where applicable. Persons with disabilities from the identified categories (locomotor disability and hearing impairment for both posts) may apply even if no vacancy is specially reserved for them, and are considered on the general eligibility standard.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay for both vacancy codes is Rs. 26,000-96,000. The notice adds that candidates moving from the 8th CPC CDA scale to the 4th PRC IDA scale on appointment get only one increment benefit, and final pay fixing follows implementation of the 4th PRC report, if any. Other benefits named: leave as per leave rules, maternity/paternity leave as per company rules for regular employees, medical facility, group insurance and leave encashment. Appointment is on one year probation from the date of joining. The employee remains on probation until the confirmation order is issued. For confirmation the candidate must pass a screening test towards the end of probation. If not passed, probation may be extended and further action follows company policy. Selected candidates may be posted anywhere in India or abroad as per company requirement. Candidates from government departments/PSUs are eligible for protection of basic pay as per company policy until they complete the service of the minimum of the pay scale.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice describes a written test, then certificate scrutiny and document verification. Appointment offers are made in order of merit to the extent of the notified vacancies, and appointment is subject to medical fitness as per RITES rules. 125 objective-type questions, one mark each, in 2.5 hours. No negative marking applies. PwBD candidates get 50 extra minutes. To be considered further, UR/EWS candidates need at least 50% marks, and SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwBD candidates against reserved posts at least 45%. Candidates can choose Hindi or English for the selection process. Candidates choose two preferred test centres in the online form: Delhi/Gurugram, Kolkata, Bengaluru, Mumbai, Guwahati and Bhubaneswar. All centres except Delhi/Gurugram are tentative. RITES may allot a centre not in the candidate's preference. The exact address, date and time will be intimated separately. RG/48/26 (Civil or Architecture): drawing practice and CAD, architectural design, building types and site planning, building materials, building construction, building planning and services, RCC and steel structures, estimation and quantity surveying, surveying, fire safety, green buildings and energy codes, and contemporary construction technology. RG/49/26 (Electrical): drawing practice and CAD, basic electrical engineering, AC fundamentals, electrical materials and basic electronics, electrical machines, measurement and instruments, electrical power systems, switchgear, protection and earthing, and wiring, estimation and utilisation. Verification is only for candidates qualifying in the written test, in the ratio of 1:3 of the vacancies notified at the start. If shortfalls are found in the certificates, the notice says the candidates called for the interview after document verification will be listed on the website. Candidates called must bring all certificates in original, including those that cover the shortfall. Candidates failing to produce shortfall documents at verification before the interview have their candidature cancelled. If two or more candidates score equal marks, the older candidate is placed above the younger one in the merit list. Next candidates on the qualified list are scrutinised only if the notified vacancies are not filled by the first verification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies: 4 for RG/48/26 (Civil or Architecture) and 2 for RG/49/26 (Electrical), all Senior Technical Assistant (Draftsman/Buildings). The notice says the number may change.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for RITES Senior Technical Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The last date for online application and fee payment is 15 December 2026. Applications opened on 16 November 2026, so the window is currently open.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for RITES Senior Technical Assistant (Draftsman/Buildings)?
faq.answer: RG/48/26 needs a full-time diploma in Civil / Architecture Engineering and RG/49/26 a full-time diploma in Electrical Engineering. Both need 2 years' post-qualification experience, including 2 years' building drawing work on AutoCAD or equivalent software.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 32 years for both posts, as on 15 December 2026. SC/ST get 5 years, OBC (NCL) 3 years, Jammu and Kashmir domicile 5 years and PwBD 10 years of relaxation.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of RITES Senior Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: The pay for both posts is Rs. 26,000-96,000. Benefits named in the notice include leave, medical facility, group insurance and leave encashment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: General/OBC candidates pay Rs. 300 plus applicable tax, and EWS/SC/ST/PwBD candidates pay Rs. 100 plus applicable tax. It is paid online while applying, and SC/ST/PwBD fee is refunded as per the notice's conditions.

faq.answer: No, negative marking does not apply, so no marks are deducted for wrong answers. UR/EWS candidates need 50% and reserved-category candidates against reserved posts need 45% to be considered further.

faq.answer: The notice speaks of regular recruitment with a one-year probation from joining, and confirmation depends on a screening test and satisfactory verification of documents. The employee remains on probation until the confirmation order.
